## Introduction of society
OMEGA is a prestigious watch brand worldwide known for its quality, precision and innovation requirements for over 170 years. Our watches are among the most beautiful in the world and are characterized by their state-of-the-art technology and timeless style.

Over the course of our long history, we have broken records of precision, redefined sporting timing and maintained our position at the cutting edge of Haute Horlogerie.

As an international brand, we are always interested in meeting future colleagues wishing to contribute to the work of our teams on almost every continent with their talents, ambitions and inspirations.

TO COMPLETE OUR SPACE PARTS TEAM, WE ARE RECOGNIZED

• Supply various components for OMEGA workshops and service centres worldwide.

• Analyze the need for resupply according to the consumption, stocks and needs of our customers

• Establish bid requests, purchase orders and follow the full administrative flow (confirmations, invoices, return management, etc.)

• Regular contacts with your suppliers (visits, regular portfolio updates).

• Management and optimization of end-of-life processes of stocks and associated operations

• Preparation of departmental statistics in collaboration with the head.

## Profile
• You benefit from commercial or technical training

• Experience in procurement (ideally in the watch industry)

• Confirmed experience in the analysis and ownership of procurement and/or procurement projects

• Good knowledge of SAP operating system

• Of an open and communicative nature, you show a very good sense of negotiation and a strong spirit of analysis. Focusing on teamwork, customer satisfaction is your main goal

• French mother tongue (or German with a good understanding of the French language)

## The company
OMEGA is a prestigious global brand with more than 170 years of commitment to quality, precision and innovation. Our watches are among the world’s finest, defined by industry-leading technology and timeless aesthetic appeal.

In our long history, we’ve set precision records, defined sports timing and remained at fine watchmaking’s cutting edge.

As an international brand, we are always interested in meeting future colleagues who are prepared to contribute their talents, ambitions and inspiration to our teams on practically every continent.

## Job description
• Design, develop, and deliver training programs for sales teams that address the specific needs of retail and wholesale staff, with the goal of maximizing sales performance.

• Conduct training sessions internationally and at Headquarters on OMEGA’s products, services, and sales techniques for retail and wholesales employees, using various methods such as classroom instruction, on-the-job training, workshops, and virtual presentations.

• Develop training materials, presentations, and resources to support training initiatives, ensuring they are current and engaging.

• Demonstrate continuous ownership and accountability for assigned projects.

• Coordinate and support local training teams, ensuring ongoing monitoring of their training plans and activities.

• Coach local trainers and sales associates on luxury selling techniques, clienteling, and high-end customer experience standards, to help achieve boutique sales targets.

• Ensure that sales associates have in-depth knowledge of boutique products and can effectively communicate their features and benefits to customers.

• Identify local training needs, gather and consolidate feedback on completed programs, and provide recommendations to drive improvements.

• Support local trainers in assessing boutique sales staff performance, delivering constructive feedback, and collaborating on tailored improvement plans to drive improvements.

## Profile
• Proven work experience as a Sales Trainer or similar role

• Ability to conduct training sessions, coaching, and interactive activities that engage sales staff and ensure alignment with Headquarters strategies

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to motivate sales staff at various levels of seniority

• Skilled in creating clear, concise, well-organized, and grammatically correct written documents

• Digital proficiency with capability to structure lessons and to create contents for e-learning platforms

## Professional requirements
• Passionate about people development, with a collaborative and flexible approach to learning and growth.

• Strong team player, experienced in collaborating with stakeholders across functions and locations

• Reliable, with excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities

• Willing and flexible to travel up to 50%

## Languages
• Fluent German and English

• Good knowledge of French, any additional language is an asset

## Introduzione della società
OMEGA è un marchio di orologi di livello mondiale noto per le sue esigenze di qualità, precisione e innovazione da oltre 170 anni. I nostri orologi sono tra i più belli del mondo e sono caratterizzati dalla loro tecnologia all'avanguardia e dallo stile senza tempo.

Nel corso della nostra lunga storia, abbiamo rotto i record di precisione, ridefinito i tempi sportivi e mantenuto la nostra posizione all'avanguardia dell'Alta Orologeria.

Come brand internazionale, siamo sempre interessati a incontrare i futuri colleghi che desiderano contribuire al lavoro dei nostri team in quasi tutti i continenti con i loro talenti, ambizioni e ispirazioni.

## Descrizione del post
Assicurare progettazione, sviluppo, manutenzione ed evoluzione dei modelli Anaplan che supportano i processi di pianificazione Supply Chain.

Garantirai e parteciperai attivamente alla definizione, progettazione, sviluppo, test e distribuzione dei modelli applicativi Anaplan per supportare i processi aziendali e le esigenze aziendali.

Pur garantendo agli utenti l'accesso (gestione e ruoli di autorizzazione), il supporto (formazione e documentazione) e il funzionamento ottimale dell'applicazione (manutenzione e supporto delle caratteristiche e dei dati), sarete la forza trainante per proporre raccomandazioni e sviluppi della soluzione e garantire la loro attuazione in conformità con la Roadmap dell'applicazione definita.

Come giocatore centrale, assicura la coerenza e le prestazioni delle soluzioni. Contribuisci anche al miglioramento continuo dei modelli Anaplan, integrando le migliori pratiche e ottimizzando continuamente le loro prestazioni per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali.

## Profilo
Livello superiore, ingegnere o considerato equivalente (3 anni di esperienza).

Hai una certificazione Minimo Livello 3 Solution Architect Anaplan o Model Builder, completata da una significativa esperienza nella progettazione e nell'architettura del modello. Si beneficia di una buona esperienza nei processi di pianificazione di Supply Chain.

È possibile uno spostamento verso i progetti di accompagnamento per migliorare i nostri processi di fornitura.

Molto collaborativo, agile, strutturato, si è in grado di evolvere in un ambiente multidisciplinare che richiede un forte impegno a lungo termine. Hai anche una forte capacità di pensiero critico, problem solving, e ti distingue per le tue abilità analitiche e concettuali.

## Introduction of society
OMEGA is a prestigious watch brand worldwide known for its quality, precision and innovation requirements for over 170 years. Our watches are among the most beautiful in the world and are characterized by their state-of-the-art technology and timeless style.

Over the course of our long history, we have broken records of precision, redefined sporting timing and maintained our position at the cutting edge of Haute Horlogerie.

As an international brand, we are always interested in meeting future colleagues wishing to contribute to the work of our teams on almost every continent with their talents, ambitions and inspirations.

## Description of post
Ensure design, development, maintenance and evolution of Anaplan models supporting Supply Chain planning processes.

You will guarantee and actively participate in the definition, design, development, testing and deployment of Anaplan application models to support business processes and business needs.

While guaranteeing users access (authorization management & roles), support (training & documentation) and optimal application operation (maintenance & support of features and data), you will be the driving force for proposing recommendations and developments of the solution and guaranteeing their implementation in accordance with the Roadmap of the defined application.

As a central player, you ensure the consistency and performance of solutions. You also contribute to the continuous improvement of Anaplan models, integrating best practices and continuously optimizing their performance to meet business needs.

##
• Profile
Higher level, engineer or deemed equivalent (3 years experience).

You have a Minimum Level 3 Solution Architect Anaplan or Model Builder certification, complemented by significant experience in model design and architecture. You benefit from very good experience in the planning processes of Supply Chain.

A shift towards accompanying projects to improve our Delivery Supply processes is possible.

Very collaborative, agile, structured, you are able to evolve in a multidisciplinary environment requiring a strong long-term commitment. You also have a strong capacity for critical thinking, problem solving, and you stand out for your analytical and conceptual skills.
